description: Employee with wages exactly at the Social Security wage base.
worked:
One employee, one employer, wages 184,500 in 2026.
Social Security (OASDI) employee tax: 2026 wage base 184,500; wages subject = smaller of 184,500 and 184,500 = 184,500 (wages are at the base); 6.2% x 184,500 = 11,439.
Medicare (hospital insurance) employee tax: no wage base; 1.45% x 184,500 = 2,675.25 (the 0.9% additional Medicare tax is figured on Form 8959 with the return, not here).
